description: NOAA AIS vessel density provides a 100-metre AIS vessel-density grid for 2013 US offshore traffic. The provider is NOAA. Geographical and temporal coverage: The NOAA metadata cover the contiguous United States offshore waters for 2013; density is a relative measure, not an actual vessel count. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. The existing Marine Cadastre record covers underlying AIS and annual track products; the inland density record covers different years and inland geography. This metadata record is the named offshore 2013 raster derivative.
